content: Freqtrade/FreqAI: open-source, ships backtesting with realistic sliding-window retraining emulation, dry-run (paper) and live modes sharing the strategy code, constant background retraining in live. Weakness: standard backtest fills every order at the requested price with no slippage if within the candle high/low - slippage config has been a long-standing open request. No first-class live-vs-backtest divergence dashboard.
